title: Low-Resource Counterspeech Generation for Indic Languages: The Case of Bengali and Hindi
reasoning: The paper focuses on generating counterspeech to mitigate abusive content in Indic languages. While the dataset deals with hate speech targeting protected groups like religious communities and evaluates the models for toxicity ('abusiveness') and discourse strategies like empathy, it does not benchmark religious knowledge, moral reasoning, or ethical philosophy as a primary research goal.
